claims.rule: When removing synchronization from runtime state, enumerate foreign readers as well as writers. Preserve diagnostic observation that does not require the blocked subject fiber to process a message; inspect weak-collection operations for hidden mutation and distinguish best-effort snapshots from a promised linearizable view.
claims.applicability: Observed in the rejected child-set portion of PR 8819, with incremental platform-refactoring context from PR 318. The Loom scenario was a stated forward-compatibility concern in 2024, not an observed failure under a shipped Loom runtime. A later lock-free implementation may satisfy the invariant differently. The direct access path removes one subject-progress dependency, not all possible dump delays or a strict latency bound. A pinned blocked-reader test specification is newly proposed and unexecuted; the neighboring roots test does not cover it.
claims.counterexample: A genuinely owner-confined structure with no external observation contract may be accessed only by its owner. Do not introduce global locking solely because the structure is mutable; conversely, debugging-only readers are still real observers when their progress is part of operational behavior.

claims.rule: When refactoring runtime child tracking, trace reverse observation edges as well as child-to-parent pointers. Test A spawning B spawning C, B finishing while C stays live, and later observation/interruption from A; preserve the selected version's policy without retaining every completed ancestor indefinitely.
claims.applicability: Observed 2019 ZIO 1-development review and final source, with a 2024 ZIO 2 traversal consumer. The cross-era review procedure is an inference; parent-completion lifetime semantics must be rediscovered rather than copied between major versions. The historical test is not a deterministic parent-completion barrier.
claims.counterexample: A child already terminated or intentionally daemonized under the version's documented ownership policy need not remain in its old parent set. A stale best-effort observation during transfer is not by itself permanent loss or a demand to retain zombie ancestors.
